description: Browse freesound.org sounds that match the scene's key and BPM, preview them through the cue, and one-click add them as sampler tracks. One-shots first (loops later). Bring your own Freesound API credentials — search and preview with just an API key, connect via OAuth for original-quality WAV import. License-aware: CC0 + CC BY by default, a license badge on every result, and attribution metadata persisted with every import.
